rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent dominant bar-like mass across all views, so it avoids the fragmented/misaligned failure. The bent/cantilevered body gives a recognizable gesture, and the top void plus ground carve provide some public-space logic. However, the mass remains fairly boxy and the section is only weakly articulated relative to the neighborhood-living brief: the access edge is not strongly resolved into a clearly public threshold in the visible views, and the void does not yet feel fully anchored as a usable ground court. The form has partial resonance with the references in its stepped/tapered mass continuity and low-commercial ground edge, but it is less expressive and less program-literate than the strongest precedents. Overall it is passable as an early massing candidate, but it would benefit from a cleaner access-side carve and a more explicit section/profile move.
